title: Shattered Golden Fragments
description: Three broken rectangular panels with glowing golden cracks and symbols float against a dark abstract background filled with colorful bokeh orbs. Smaller golden fragments and script-like markings drift below the main pieces.
prompt: Surreal composition of three broken dark rectangular panels floating in space, repaired and connected with glowing golden cracks in kintsugi style, faint mysterious symbols and script visible on surfaces, smaller golden fragments and calligraphy drifting below, set against a deep black background filled with soft out-of-focus colorful bokeh orbs in purple, pink, blue and green tones, mystical atmosphere, cinematic lighting
